definition: a cloth wing on strings pulled by the wind
description: A young travel vlogger films himself on a trip. First he walks beside a truck covered in bright hand-painted flowers with a peacock painted on its side, and puts his hand on it. Then he stands at a wooden railing under strings of prayer flags, looking out at a snow-covered mountain range lit orange by the sun above a deep valley. Finally, on a city rooftop at sunset with domes and minarets behind him, he holds a string and flies a red kite while dozens of coloured kites fill the sky around him.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er lässt einen roten Drachen steigen.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está haciendo volar una cometa roja.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il fait voler un cerf-volant rouge.
fr.question: Que fait le jeune homme ?
